races.paceDynamic: Roc Dino will lead from the start with his proven front-running style, while Speculateur and Hawk's Rock track him in prominent positions. The confirmed pace-setter won't face early pressure in this small field, allowing him to dictate a moderate gallop that may not expose stamina limitations over this extended trip. With most runners adopting hold-up tactics (Loch Cuan, Brohatna, Evangelic, Herecomesmybaby), the pace will be steady early before quickening from the second-last hurdle. This controlled tempo strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace without expending early energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Class
scenarios.trigger: If Roc Dino maintains a steady gallop without early pressure from the field.
scenarios.body: The measured tempo allows Speculateur to utilize his superior class and hurdles experience, while Roc Dino stays competitive from his forward position. The lack of early pace pressure means both prominent runners can save energy for a sustained finish over the final 3-4 furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Roc Dino gets an uncontested lead and the hold-up horses fail to close the gap.
scenarios.body: The Mullins runner exploits his tactical advantage by controlling the race from pillar to post, with Paul Townend able to quicken when it matters most. The bunch of hold-up horses leave themselves too much to do from off the pace in testing ground conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the closing horses get optimal racing room.
scenarios.body: Loch Cuan and Evangelic benefit from a crawling gallop that sets up a sprint finish, allowing their hold-up style to be effective despite the small field. The lack of early pace means stamina becomes less important than a turn of foot in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders underperform and Union Boy shows debut promise or Hawk's Rock returns to Galway form.
scenarios.body: The newcomer Union Boy benefits from race fitness questions surrounding others, while Hawk's Rock could bounce back after his poor Cheltenham effort last time. The combination of a moderate pace and class horses potentially regressing opens the door for an upset.

watchPoints.text: Roc Dino getting an uncontested lead - if no horse challenges early, he could steal a significant advantage turning for home.
Union Boy's market moves and betting patterns - any support would suggest stable confidence in this complete unknown.
Speculateur's jumping under pressure - has been consistent but needs to improve his jumping when the pace lifts.
How quickly Loch Cuan can get into contention - hold-up style is risky in small fields where pace can collapse.
Evangelic's hurdles technique on debut - flat form suggests regression but obstacles could revive his career.

races.paceDynamic: Kalsman is the sole confirmed front runner and likely pacemaker, having won at this course and distance and shown positive form recently. With minimal early pace pressure from 18 runners, he can dictate a steady gallop that builds gradually over the 2m6f trip. The lack of other natural leaders means prominent runners like Loup De Tallane, Stonecarthy and Annarubyrose will track behind but not apply serious early pressure. This moderate early pace followed by a sustained finish strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the leaders will have more left in the tank when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Kalsman leads uncontested and the pace stays steady until 3f out
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows hold-up horses to close strongly while early leaders fade from the sustained finish. Patient rides on proven stayers with tactical speed benefit most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too slow and no one pressures Kalsman meaningfully
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the final bend, suiting those already positioned handy who don't need to make up ground. Front-runners and prominent racers capitalize on poor positioning behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection Changes Shape
scenarios.trigger: If prominent runners move up to pressure Kalsman approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: The injection of pace stretches the field and creates a more genuine gallop that suits horses with proven stamina. Those who can quicken from midfield positions while maintaining their finishing kick prosper.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Suits Opportunists
scenarios.trigger: If no clear pace pattern emerges and the race becomes stop-start with positional shuffling
scenarios.body: The tactical nature allows adaptable horses with good jockeys to find the right position at the right time. Recent course experience and tactical awareness become crucial factors.

watchPoints.text: Kalsman must be monitored early as the sole pace angle - if he doesn't jump well or gets pressured early the entire race shape changes
Several runners carry late-fading warnings (Stonecarthy, Justicialism, Artic Chief, Gangster Granny) which could create a false pace if they're positioned prominently
Multiple long-absent runners (Loup De Tallane 201d, Annarubyrose 271d, L'Un Deux Trois 252d) may need the run
King Gris showed heavy ground preference in his wins but disappointed on good ground last time at this venue
Bearami Creek and Fool Me Once represent the main hold-up threats if the pace scenario develops as expected

races.paceDynamic: Nevermindestranger stands as the sole confirmed front runner in this 18-runner maiden hurdle field, creating a tactical advantage as he won't face early pressure. Free Vango, Rare Times, Lemmy Caution, and Echinacea will settle prominently behind the leader, but their positioning suggests more reactive than aggressive tactics. The large field and lack of multiple pace pressers means Nevermindestranger can dictate fractions through the early stages, likely creating a steady gallop that builds from the home turn. This pace dynamic strongly favours prominent runners and patient hold-up horses who can benefit from the sustainable early tempo and have room to manoeuvre in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Nevermindestranger maintains a steady early gallop without serious challenge.
scenarios.body: The controlled pace allows him to reserve energy for the finish while others struggle to close from off the tempo. His point-to-point placing and hurdles form suggests stamina to see out the trip when not pressured.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens from halfway as prominent horses move forward together.
scenarios.body: Free Vango, Rare Times and Lemmy Caution benefit from tracking the leader without doing early work, positioning them perfectly for sustained challenges. Their tactical positions allow first strike on any weakening front runner.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates a truly run race with traffic problems for prominent runners.
scenarios.body: Patient hold-up types like Flying Ace, Endless Talking and Dancing Fruits get clear runs in the straight as others tire. The Gordon Elliott-trained Flying Ace particularly benefits from a strongly run contest over this trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Flat Form Transfers
scenarios.trigger: If Echinacea's recent Dundalk form translates effectively to hurdles debut.
scenarios.body: Her four runner-up efforts in six starts since November demonstrates current form and tactical speed that others lack. The step up to hurdles suits her stamina-laden pedigree and she can quicken when others hit the wall.

watchPoints.text: Nevermindestranger faces no early pace pressure which could allow him to steal a decisive advantage
Free Vango raced too keenly on debut and may repeat the mistake with similar early positioning

races.paceDynamic: Camlin Park stands alone as the confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from flag to flag without early pressure. With limited pace elsewhere, Mercurial Sea may track in second but the overall gallop will be steady rather than searching. This creates a tactical race where the pace will build gradually, with the real racing beginning from 3 furlongs out as the hold-up horses make their moves. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed over pure hold-up horses who need a stronger pace to be effective.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Camlin Park reproduces his maiden hurdle form and gets an easy lead
scenarios.body: The favourite controls the race from pillar to post and kicks clear when the pressure comes, making his class advantage tell. Hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes strong enough in the middle stages to set up the closers
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the better handicapped horses pay off as Camlin Park's lack of recent form shows late. A Snow White Park or Lagoon Nebula time their runs to perfection from off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Mercurial Sea or Sea Of Doubt can stay close to Camlin Park throughout
scenarios.body: The tracking horse gets first run on the leader and has enough in reserve to pull away, benefiting from a perfect trip in behind the pace-setter. Camlin Park's stamina gives way under pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders all underperform and the pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: A lightly raced improver like Baby Fish or Doing It In Style takes advantage of a slowly run race to show unexpected progression. The Cromwell pair benefit from their trainer's excellent 14-day record.

races.paceDynamic: Finnians Row and Bocelli's Voice from the McLoughlin yard will likely share early pace duties with prominent runner Katzoff, creating a steady gallop rather than breakneck speed. The moderate tempo will allow hold-up horses like Tsavo Park, Struck Oil and Jouster to stay in touch throughout the middle stages. Over this testing 2m3½f trip on good to soft ground, stamina becomes crucial in the final half-mile as the early pace-setters tire. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can conserve energy early and produce sustained finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady and sustainable as expected
scenarios.body: The McLoughlin front-runners will weaken in the final half-mile, allowing closers with stamina reserves to sweep past. Tsavo Park and Struck Oil are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical advantage with their patient racing styles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Persist
scenarios.trigger: If Finnians Row or Bocelli's Voice find their second wind late
scenarios.body: One of the McLoughlin pair could defy expectations and stay on strongly, having established the ideal tactical position. Their course experience and stamina reserves at this trip could prove decisive against tiring closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Outsider Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Lightweights Katzoff and Just For Yuse could benefit from the weight relief as classier rivals tire badly. Their reduced burden becomes a significant advantage when stamina reserves are depleted across the field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Favourite Fails Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Tsavo Park's jumping lets him down under pressure
scenarios.body: His chasing inexperience shows at crucial fences, opening the door for more reliable jumpers. Struck Oil or Hello Johnjoe could capitalize on the favourite's mistake with clean jumping performances.

races.paceDynamic: Difficult Decision appears the only confirmed front runner in this 14-runner field, likely to dictate from the front without serious early pressure. The prominent runners like Dinoland, Person Of Interest and My Cullen will track the leader but shouldn't create significant early pace pressure. With many hold-up horses including Hardy Diamond, My Good Pal, Shantou Show and Mastermind, the race should develop into a tactical affair before quickening from the back of the last fence. This sustainable early gallop followed by a sprint finish strongly favours the hold-up horses who can deliver their challenge late when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady as expected with Difficult Decision uncontested.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last fence where the fresher hold-up horses can quicken past the tiring leaders. Hardy Diamond, My Good Pal and Mastermind are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Dinoland or Person Of Interest can track the steady pace and kick approaching the last.
scenarios.body: These prominent runners avoid the traffic of the hold-up brigade while having enough left to resist late challengers. Their tactical position becomes the winning formula in a moderately-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners decide to pressure Difficult Decision from early.
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop finds out the stamina reserves and favours the proven stayers who can handle the extended 2m7½f trip. This pace collapse scenario suits horses with solid chase experience.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Difficult Decision faces no serious challenges and maintains his lead throughout.
scenarios.body: The 13-year-old veteran uses his experience to control the race completely and holds off late challengers who leave their runs too late. His sustainable pace proves perfect for the trip.
